name: quant-strategy-management
description: Standalone quantitative strategy asset management with Strategy DSL parsing, persistence, daily backtests, and report artifacts.
description_cn: 独立量化策略资产管理，支持 Strategy DSL 解析、持久化、日线回测和报告产物。
workflow: Parse a strategy idea into a controlled Strategy DSL when the user starts from natural language.
Save the strategy and versioned DSL when the configuration should become a reusable asset.
Run a daily backtest to generate summary, trades, equity curve, and HTML report artifacts.
Keep all results framed as research support rather than guaranteed investment advice.

script_entries.name: quant_strategy_cli
script_entries.description: Standalone CLI for parsing, saving, listing, and backtesting quantitative strategies.
